name: Etropo
description:
Etropo brings your marketing budget into the conversation. Ask questions in plain language - "how much have we spent on paid media this quarter?", "which line items are over budget?" - and get answers grounded in your real planned and actual spend, synced automatically from Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta, and more.

Query and analyze: Retrieve line items, channels, and budget versions; compare planned vs. actual spend and surface variances instantly.

Update as you go: Add line items, set planned amounts, approve items, and reassign owners or categories — no spreadsheet needed.

Ground strategy in your knowledge: Browse your organization's Marketing Brain — personas, channels, metrics, and campaign learnings — and save new learnings as you work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Etropo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Etropo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.etropo.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Etropo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Etropo provides these MCP tools: add_categories, add_line_items, add_marketing_context_fact, analyze_variance, list_budget_versions, list_marketing_context, read_marketing_context_entries, retrieve_channels, retrieve_line_items, search_marketing_context, update_line_item_values, and update_line_items.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Etropo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Etropo in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Etropo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Etropo is developed by Etropo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
